The '''EV motivator''' was a model of [[Motivator/Legends|motivator]] that [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]] intended to install in their [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor droid]].<ref name="NEGTD" /> However, an employee substituted a case of EV motivators with a case of [[MDF motivator]]s that were meant to be installed in [[Interrogation droid/Legends|torture droids]]. The result was a large number of EV-series [[Supervisor droid/Legends|supervisor droids]] developed personalities that were described as "ruthless," "vicious," and "psychotic."<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> The affected [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were recalled by MerenData to exchange the motivators.<ref name="SGTD">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The EV motivator was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]'', a [[1999]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EGTD" />
